# fx fixtures

These parent and child sessions were captured with fx v0.0.13. The format
source is pinned to
[vercel-labs/fx at b9ca60d](https://github.com/vercel-labs/fx/tree/b9ca60d0102cf84cea061456c41206f66149b311).

Paths and opaque IDs use example values. The fixtures preserve event order,
timestamps, tool arguments and previews, and cumulative usage. Parent child
registries and full tool-result artifacts are omitted.
